# DEM NaN NoData Small

<div class="gc-badges">

A float32 DEM that marks NoData with NaN rather than a sentinel value. NaN propagates through means and comparisons instead of being excluded.

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase detects NaN-encoded NoData in a float DEM rather than treating NaN as valid elevation.

## Risk types covered

- [`nodata/ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
- [`nodata/nan_mishandled`](../risk/nodata-nan-mishandled.md)

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `32633` |
| `expect_nodata` | yes |
| `expected_band_count` | `1` |
| `expected_dtype` | `float32` |
| `expected_shape` | `[16, 16]` |
| `nodata_convention` | `nan` |
| `expected_compression` | `deflate` |
| `expected_band_names` | `elevation` |
